about: A personal injury attorney with The Champion Firm, P.C., Darl Champion represents clients all over Metro Atlanta in his office based in Marietta, GA. His experience includes personal injury cases related to motor vehicle wrecks and medical malpractice , as well as general personal injury, and he is passionate about making sure his clients are compensated when they are injured by the negligence of another. With a commitment to being accessible to his clients, he focuses on open communication and makes their needs a priority.

Admitted to practice in the state of Georgia, Mr. Champion is also admitted to practice before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 11th Circuit, the Georgia Supreme Court and the Georgia Court of Appeals. He is also admitted before the U.S. District Court for the Northern, Middle and Southern Districts of Georgia.

Mr. Champion graduated summa cum laude from Methodist University with a Bachelor of Arts before attending law school. At Mercer University, he graduated magna cum laude with his Juris Doctor. He currently has an Avvo “Superb” rating, was named one of America’s Top 100 Personal Injury Attorneys in 2020 and is a member of the National Trial Lawyers: Top 100 and the National Trial Lawyers: Top 40 Under 40.

During his career Mr. Champion has recovered millions of dollars for his clients whose lives were changed because of an injury cause by another person or organization. This earned him membership into the Million Dollar Advocates Forum and the Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum, and he is also a member of the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association.
